name: DubTab
tagline: Turn any tab into live AI dubbing with bilingual subtitles. DubTab translates playing audio in real time across 50+ languages.
description: If a course, stream, or video plays sound, DubTab can dub and caption it live. The Android app covers YouTube, TikTok, Twitch, and most apps on the phone; the Chrome and Edge extension covers browser tabs; the Windows and Mac desktop app covers system or single-app audio. You get real-time AI dubbing, optional bilingual subtitles, voice selection, and ducking of the original track. Translation lands in roughly half a second across 50+ languages. On Android you can also start from Share or dub a video file and save a copy. One freemium account covers the extension, desktop app, and Android app.
